description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kahathuduwa, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District  - Cad. Map No. 520037
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land title registration under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a formal declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding the determination of title to a specific parcel of land (Parcel No. 22, Block 14) with detailed land particulars including location, extent, owner information, and title classification. This falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) as it deals with land registration and title settlement matters.
